script_text: Stop—Gemini, your chart is cracking open right now. Your ruling planet Mercury stations direct in your 6th House of daily work, while the Sun there forms a stabilizing trine to Saturn in your 11th House of alliances. Delayed tasks, confusing messages, and stuck schedules begin to move, and a friend or group gives you practical support. As an air sign, you think in words, so ask for the missing detail instead of guessing. Taken Gemini, a relationship settles when you stop letting work stress become distance. Single Gemini, you attract someone through routine, class, or a shared project. In your 2nd House of money, Jupiter square Neptune warns against vague offers from teams—get every number in writing. Avoid signing anything you cannot explain out loud, and watch for an unexpected mentor through a friend. Follow for tomorrow’s reading so you don’t miss what the stars reveal next.

title: Gemini: The Message You’ve Been Waiting For
youtube_description: Mercury stations direct in your 6th House while the Sun trines Saturn, and the clarity is about to hit your work and love life.
